answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a delay chain into a public river ordered by filing time. One funding grove advances one chain per epoch: the k-th identity from one root waits k epochs; no parallel runs. Each chain costs 45 credits: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Auditors replay the river at dawn; rented or copied chains burn the bond. An honest agent files once, pays 45, keeps its full share.
